verified_modalities.seizure_annotations: verified_present: events.tsv per ictal run; 'soz' tags in channels.tsv status_description (checked sub-HUP060)

intervention_linkage.basis: channels.tsv status_description contains 'resect' tags (README: channels overlapping the resection/ablation zone determined by segmenting the resection cavity); sub-HUP132 first channels.tsv had no 'resect' tag
intervention_linkage.intervention_classes: participants.tsv 'therapy': RESECTION 29, ABLATION (laser) 29; 'RNS' level defined in participants.json but no RNS rows

outcome_fields_present: participants.tsv: 'engel' (original subclass e.g. 1A..4A), 'outcome' S/F; aggregate only here: S=36 / F=22 (RESECTION S22 F7; ABLATION S14 F15). Per-patient labels must be sealed by R2/vault before modeling.
follow_up_definition: not_reported in dataset metadata (no follow-up duration column); Kini 2019 (subset) reports outcome 'measured at a minimum of 1 year after surgery' -> to_verify per patient
eligibility: Best fit to protocol: iEEG + localisation + contact-level resection/ablation linkage + Engel class. Caveats: follow-up length per patient not in metadata; coordinate frame discrepancy; no stimulation intervention; no MRI for TVB connectome building (would need atlas/normative connectome).
cohort_overlap: Same Penn/HUP family as candidate-epivr (Kini 2019; HUP080 named in Kini 2019 is in ds004100) and Omni-iEEG 'hup' subset (58 sub-hupHUP*).
